# Study timer

Start a pomodoro timer for the user.

1. Run `node C:\Users\dev\skills\study-timer\timer.mjs 25` (on a Mac: `node /Users/dev/skills/study-timer/timer.mjs 25`).
2. Tell the user when the time is up, and suggest a 5-minute break.
